answer: A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 96 epochs of grading, and every river settlement recomputes the spiral schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 96 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
